count_principles.skipped: Gate skips are terminal bookkeeping and not scientific success.
count_principles.partial: Partial outputs cannot feed headline branches.
count_principles.null: Null outcomes need their own controls and must not be counted as positive.
count_principles.flagged: Flagged artifacts are quarantined from claims even when terminal.
count_principles.retired: Retired scopes remain closed unless a valid override exists.
count_principles.ready: Ready is counted separately from complete and positive evidence.
count_principles.complete: Complete artifacts may still be blocked from claims by flags or gates.
